dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Cardinals (3-8) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Commanders
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Mike LaFleur and the medical staff evaluate C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion), QB Carson Beck (back), G Jon Gaines II (ankle), and LB Cody Simon (calf) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Darren Urban](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4430841/carson-beck#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Mike%20LaFleur%20said%20Beck%20%28back%29). DT Zachary Carter (knee) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation.

Week 12 Commanders Outlook: Mike LaFleur and DC Nick Rallis open installation for the Washington Commanders (4-5-1, WSH -7, HC Dan Quinn, OC David Blough & DC Daronte Jones (State Farm Stadium))—a unit ranked #3 in Turnover Differential (+7) as Arizona prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Seth Cox](https://www.revengeofthebirds.com/arizona-cardinals-odds/97314/cardinals-vs-commanders-odds-week-12-opening-lines-point-spread-total).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-8 (4th in NFC West • #16 Seed in NFC), Arizona carries a 0% postseason projection, 0% NFC West division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [azcardinals.com Official](https://www.azcardinals.com/news/carson-beck-remains-sidelined-for-now-with-bad-back-cardinals-qb).

Around the Beat: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that the Cardinals will evaluate Love (ankle) again Monday to hone in on a return date for the running back [Bo Brack](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4870808/jeremiyah-love#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Mike%20LaFleur%20said%20Wednesday%20that).
